_about: Inputs of cost.mjs. 'measured' values come from the runs of 2026-11-12 in PERF.md and COST.md. 'assumed' values are guesses that a cloud test must replace.

included._source: Workers Paid, each month: 25 GiB-hours of memory, 375 vCPU-minutes, 200 GB-hours of disk, 400,000 GB-s and 1 million requests of Durable Objects, 1 million class A and 10 million class B R2 operations, 10 million Worker requests

engine._measured: Claude Code 2.1.311, sonnet, docker mode on one Mac, 2026-11-12

engine_at._measured: Claude Code 2.1.311, sonnet, docker mode, SANDBOX_CPUS=0.25, 2026-11-12: a program that waited 50 s still took 12.4 s from the job to its end, and the cgroup counted 3.6 vCPU-s for its start and 3.6 for the run (0.7 to 1.0 at 1/2 or 2 vCPU).

codex._measured: Codex 0.167.2. Busy: 10.4 to 13.8 s from the start to the end of codex exec with the real model (host mode, 4 runs). CPU: the stand-in model run in the image took 0.16 to 0.25 vCPU-s at 1/4 vCPU and 0.21 at 2 vCPU with a warm page cache (codex-standin.mjs). No program waits, so a Codex container uses no CPU between runs.

cloud._assumed: Not measured on Cloudflare. start_s: the FAQ says cold starts are often 1 to 3 s. restore_s and save_s: the credential folder (512 KB) from and to R2.
